rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a physical pile of similar objects.

example.english: There’s a stack of documents on the desk, so don’t put any more there.
example.traditional: 張枱上面有一堆文件，唔好再擺喇。
example.jyutping: zoeng1 ci4 soeng6 min6 jau5 jat1 deoi1 man4 gin6 m4 hou2 zoi3 baai2 laa3

rows.note: Use this for a large amount of something, especially when the amount is emphasized rather than the neat arrangement.

example.english: The teacher gave me a stack of homework to do.
example.traditional: 老師畀咗我一大堆功課做。
example.jyutping: lou5 si1 bei2 zo2 ngo5 jat1 daai6 deoi1 gung1 fo3 zou6

rows.note: Use this specifically for a pile of hay, straw, or grass.

example.english: There’s a stack of hay behind the farm.
example.jyutping: nung4 coeng4 hau6 min6 jau5 go3 daai6 cou2 deoi1
